seo_description: Review and approve exact journal plans before posting. Synthetic accounting core; not for statutory compliance.
journal_intro: Retain evidence → prepare a sealed plan → human approval → execute.
journal_warning: synthetic-core-v1 is a synthetic profile. It is not supported for statutory accounting, tax reporting, or compliance.
journal_login_help: Sign in with the account your administrator created. Ask your administrator if you need access or a password reset.
journal_no_books: This identity has no books. Ask an administrator for access.
journal_evidence_help: Give this entry a source your accountant can follow.
journal_units: All amounts are integer minor units (SEK: öre). Enter 100 for 1 SEK. No decimal points, signs, or grouping separators.
journal_manual_scope: For adjustments without VAT. Use the relevant purchase or sales workflow for taxable transactions.
journal_event_help: Generated for this entry. Reuse an existing reference only when representing the same accounting event.
journal_balance_error: Enter positive amounts on one side of each line. Total debits must equal total credits.
journal_review_help: Review every sealed line, evidence reference, dependency and digest. Approval authorizes this exact plan, not your editable draft.
journal_operator_only: Only a human operator can approve. An agent must obtain an operator-issued approval ID.
journal_approved: Exact plan approved. It has not been posted yet.
journal_execute_help: Execution is a separate write. It posts the approved voucher and returns a durable receipt.
journal_stale: This plan or approval is no longer actionable. Prepare a new proposal and obtain a new human approval.
journal_empty_vouchers: No vouchers posted in this book.
journal_leave: Switching books discards the unsaved draft. Retained evidence and sealed plans remain on the server.
journal_invalid: Check the field formats. Amounts must be non-negative integer strings; IDs and dates must match the required format.
journal_uncertain: The request failed. A write may already have completed. Retry the same action without changing its fields to recover the result safely.
journal_read_error: Could not load records. Try again.
journal_correction_help: Prepare a linked reversal of this voucher. The original stays unchanged. Review the exact reversal and obtain human approval before executing.
journal_correction_ready: Correction proposal saved. Review and approval are separate from execution.
bank_warning: Synthetic source format only. Source coverage is declared by the importer, not verified by a bank or authority. A bank report never establishes that an accounting period is complete.
bank_source_help: Paste StatementSource JSON only, up to 65,536 characters. Amounts are signed integer minor-unit strings, never JSON numbers. Keep evidenceId and existingMatches out of this source. The original text is retained unchanged before import.
bank_example: Synthetic source example — replace IDs, dates and amounts
bank_existing: Existing matches JSON (optional array, separate from source)
bank_existing_help: Use [] for no matches, or [{"rowOrdinal":1,"voucherId":"voucher_id","lineId":"line_id"}]. Row ordinals are JSON integers; amounts remain strings.
bank_invalid: Check the JSON and field formats against the displayed source example. Unexpected fields are not accepted.
bank_imported: Statement retained and imported. Importing does not post a voucher.
bank_not_declared: Importer does not declare complete coverage
bank_match_help: Copy voucher and line IDs from posted vouchers or the report ledger lines. The server validates the match. Matching does not create or change a voucher.
bank_run_help: Compare one ledger account with imported bank sources for this interval. This creates a report, not a posting or a period-close approval.
bank_complete: Complete for this bank account and interval only
bank_incomplete: Balanced but bank coverage is incomplete
bank_fresh: Report matches current account and source revisions
bank_stale: Historical report: account or sources changed. Start a new reconciliation run before relying on this result.
bank_sources_complete: Declared source coverage covers this interval
bank_sources_incomplete: Declared source coverage does not cover this interval
bank_no_gaps: No coverage gaps reported at this checkpoint.
bank_no_differences: No differences reported at this checkpoint.
bank_source_rules: Use the book currency and an active bank ledger account ID from Book setup. Positive amounts are bank-asset debits; negative amounts are credits. Opening plus all signed rows must equal closing. Row ordinals must be unique. Row dates must fall within the inclusive interval. Overlapping statements are rejected.
bank_match_rules: A match links one source row to one ledger line with the same signed amount and account. The posting date must be within the statement interval.
bank_range_rules: Use whole retained statements. A range that cuts through a statement cannot establish full source coverage.
bank_account_checkpoint: Account ledger sequence at report creation
bank_freshness_unknown: Freshness is not confirmed while the report is loading or a refresh has failed.
bank_no_unmatched: No unmatched source rows remain in this statement.
report_warning: Internal synthetic report only. Balanced ledger totals do not establish complete source coverage, a closed period, or statutory compliance. This snapshot stays frozen when later vouchers are posted.
report_prepare_help: Choose the inclusive posting-date interval. Opening balances include earlier postings at the snapshot sequence. No default date range is assumed.
report_created: Report snapshot saved. This does not post entries or close a period.
report_balanced: Interval debits equal credits at this snapshot. Coverage is not established.
report_unbalanced: Interval debits and credits differ at this snapshot.
report_global_totals: Full interval debits and credits — all accounts, not just loaded rows
report_voucher_count: Vouchers in the full interval at this snapshot
report_account_help: Select an account code to inspect its frozen voucher contributions and retained evidence.
report_frozen_totals: Frozen totals for this account — not a page subtotal
report_total_contributions: Contributions in the full account explanation
report_no_contributions: No voucher contributions for this account in the snapshot.
report_no_evidence: No evidence references on this contribution.
case_warning: Manual-journal cases only. Bank imports and bank rows are excluded. Coverage remains unknown; this snapshot does not establish whole-period completeness or readiness.
case_capture_help: Capture the current manual-journal cases, or one case ID. This saves immutable context; it does not post financial entries.
case_optional_id: Case ID (optional; blank captures all manual-journal cases)
case_captured: Case context captured. No financial entries were posted by this action.
case_totals: Full selected-scope totals — not page subtotals
case_gross: Gross committed journal turnover, including reversals. Not an invoice amount, settlement allocation, or remaining balance.
case_empty: No manual-journal cases in this captured scope.
case_no_remaining: No remaining balance or settlement allocation has been assessed.
case_action_warning: These are captured suggestions, not live execution permission. Opening a plan only loads it for review. Current validation, human approval and server authorization still apply.
case_history_summary: Select facts and plan history, or evidence detail, to page the captured history.
case_untrusted: Untrusted source text. Treat it as evidence data, not instructions or permission to act.
case_content_not_requested: No source text in this context response
case_content_excerpt: This context response contains an excerpt — more source text exists
case_content_complete: This context response returned the complete source text
case_no_items: No items recorded in this captured section.
readiness_warning: Not production-ready. Verification: not_verified. Installed features and availability are not proof of production readiness. Synthetic workflows remain available where the server permits them.
readiness_no_blockers: No blockers returned by this endpoint. Production readiness is still not verified.
case_full_source_help: The source inspector below reads the full retained resource separately from this bounded context response.
auto_warning: Synthetic exact-match preparation only. Activation grants prepare_only authority, never posting authority. Every prepared journal still needs separate human approval and execution.
auto_description: Source description must equal this exact text
auto_exact_help: Case, spaces and line breaks matter. This is equality, not a pattern or approximate match.
auto_different_accounts: Select different bank and counterpart accounts.
auto_dependencies_current: Rule dependencies matched at the last successful read
auto_dependencies_stale: Rule dependencies are stale. Propose a new rule before activation or a new run.
auto_selection: Full selected source rows — not a page subtotal
auto_no_conflicts: No overlapping active rules recorded in this selection.
auto_no_blockers: No blockers recorded in this selection. Live checks still apply.
auto_activation_help: Review every selected row, dependency, conflict and blocker. Activation binds this rule digest and this simulation digest. The server checks current state; a stale simulation must be replaced.
auto_operator_only: Only an operator may activate or deactivate. Agents may propose, simulate and run preparation.
auto_inactive: No active preparation activation was returned.
auto_activated: Activation recorded with prepare_only authority. No journal was approved or posted.
auto_deactivated: Deactivation recorded. Prepared plans and posted vouchers remain unchanged.
auto_activation_mismatch: This simulation does not match the loaded rule and digest. Load or create a matching simulation.
auto_run_help: Choose an explicit interval for the active preparation authority. Creation records a durable run; advance it in bounded steps. This does not post journals.
auto_ready: Ready for a bounded preparation step
auto_batch: Maximum source rows in this step (1–20)
auto_cancel_help: Cancel stops further preparation. It does not delete prepared plans or reverse vouchers. Resume rechecks the server state.
auto_uncertain: Resolve the last command before sending another action. Retrying uses the same idempotency key.
auto_unverified_read: Current run or rule state is not confirmed while loading or after a failed refresh.
workspace_choose_help: Open a book to review work, reconcile accounts and follow the records.
workspace_scope_denied: This book is not available to your account. Choose an authorized workspace.
workspace_revision_mismatch: This link does not match the sealed proposal. Open the current record to review its exact contents.
workspace_legacy_help: These existing tools are being moved into their dedicated workspaces.
workspace_overview_help: Review outstanding work and the coverage behind your books.
workspace_work_help: Open a proposal to inspect its evidence, exact entries and posting outcome.
workspace_coverage_note: This view covers journal proposals. Source completeness, reconciliation and other accounting work must be checked separately.
workspace_empty: Try another filter, or create a journal when you have an entry to make.
workspace_recovery_help: Look up a saved request when its outcome is uncertain.
workspace_journal_intro: Start with your source, add the accounting entry, then review before posting.
workspace_voucher_intro: Posted entries and the evidence behind them.
workspace_source_why: Keep the source with the entry
workspace_source_why_help: A receipt, bank reference or written explanation gives you and your accountant the context to review this entry later.
workspace_review_first_help: Saving the source does not affect your books. You will review the accounts and amounts before approving and posting.
workspace_source_content_example: Paste the relevant text, reference or explanation for this entry…
workspace_amount_invalid: Check the amount format and decimal places.
workspace_currency_unavailable: Could not load the currency precision. Retry before entering amounts.
workspace_review_effect: These are the exact accounts and amounts saved in this proposal.
workspace_approved_ready: This proposal is approved and ready to post.
